title: The Quran Says Who Spoke First Against Every Prophet
excerpt: Twice the Quran states a rule about who objects when a warner arrives, and both times it names the same group: a town's mutrafūn — a passive participle meaning the ones who have been made soft by ease. The word occurs five times, always the same way, and the classical commentators gloss it as the town's chiefs.
seo_title: Mutrafūn: The Quran Names Who Rejected Every Warner (34:34, 43:23)
seo_description: A corpus-verified reading of mutrafūn — the passive participle the Quran uses five times for the affluent. Twice it states as a rule that they objected to every warner sent to every town.
